goal: Draft three ADRs that record the decision space for unattended Review disposition without settling it in code: runtime reviewer invocation, parked-child claim release, and batch capability rehydration after a crash.

acceptance.assertion: docs/adr/0006 records whether the runtime may invoke the reviewer itself rather than handing Review back to a foreground Host turn. It states the problem, at least two concrete options with their authority consequences, a recommendation with rationale, and status Proposed. It changes no code.

docs/adr/0007 records whether a child parked on a foreground obligation may release its claim so independent siblings continue, including what that would mean for claim ownership, the single-owner invariant, and batch settlement. Options, recommendation, and status Proposed are present; no code changes.

docs/adr/0008 records whether a batch capability can be rehydrated after a crash, including what evidence would have to survive and how it would interact with the strictly-newer-confirmation renewal rule. Options, recommendation, and status Proposed are present; no code changes.

The three drafts are internally consistent with the accepted ADR-0004 and ADR-0005 decisions, introduce no reference to a path or symbol that does not exist, and pass the repository's documentation reference guards.
